premise: There isn't a breath of wind: the sailboat can't sail, Lola's kite won't fly, and Gull won't bother; when the wind comes it fills the sails and lifts the kite.
inspiration: Aesop's North Wind fable seen from the other side: everyone waits for the wind, and it gives each of them what they need.
lesson: Good things can be worth waiting for.
learning: A sail catches the wind, and the wind pushes the boat along.

en-US.title: Waiting for the Wind
en-US.text: {sailboat:float loop 0.2} Not a breath of wind. {sailboat:enter} {sailboat:go to sea} The sailboat sat still on the flat blue sea, its white sails hanging down. {sailboat:pulse} {girl:enter} Lola stood and waited. {girl:face sad} {girl:says} [sad] "Come on, wind." {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to sand} Gull sat on the sand, {seagull:face sleeping} not even bothering to fly. [short pause] Then… a ripple. A flutter. {canvas:wind 0.7 25s} {sfx:breeze} Whoosh! Here came the wind! {sailboat:live sails} The sails puffed out, round and full. {girl:face surprised} {girl:live point} {girl:says} [excited] "Look! The wind's pushing the sail!" {girl:face happy} {girl:live kite hold} Lola let out the string, and up went her kite. {seagull:face happy} {seagull:go to girl kite} Gull woke up and flew up beside the kite. {sailboat:go to sea right} And off went the sailboat across the bay, pushed along by the wind. [happily] Wind for the boat, wind for the kite, wind under Gull's wings. {girl:hearts} Everyone had been waiting for the very same thing.

es-ES.title: Esperando al viento
es-ES.text: {sailboat:float loop 0.2} Ni una pizca de viento. {sailboat:enter} {sailboat:go to sea} El velero estaba quieto en el mar azul y liso, con las velas blancas colgando. {sailboat:pulse} {girl:enter} Lola esperaba y esperaba. {girl:face sad} {girl:says} [sad] «Venga, viento.» {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to sand} Gaviota estaba sentada en la arena, {seagull:face sleeping} sin ganas ni de volar. [short pause] Entonces… una ondita. Un aleteo. {canvas:wind 0.7 25s} {sfx:breeze} ¡Fiuuu! ¡Ya llegaba el viento! {sailboat:live sails} Las velas se hincharon, redondas y llenas. {girl:face surprised} {girl:live point} {girl:says} [excited] «¡Mira! ¡El viento empuja la vela!» {girl:face happy} {girl:live kite hold} Lola soltó hilo, y arriba subió su cometa. {seagull:face happy} {seagull:go to girl kite} Gaviota se despertó y subió volando junto a la cometa. {sailboat:go to sea right} Y el velero cruzó la bahía, empujado por el viento. [happily] Viento para el barco, viento para la cometa, viento bajo las alas de Gaviota. {girl:hearts} Todos estaban esperando lo mismo.

ja-JP.title: 風を まって
ja-JP.text: {sailboat:float loop 0.2}風が、そよりともふきません。{sailboat:enter}{sailboat:go to sea}ヨットは、たいらな青い海の上で、じっとしたまま。白い帆も、だらーん。{sailboat:pulse}{girl:enter}ローラは、立ったまま、まっていました。{girl:face sad}{girl:says}[sad]「風さん、ふいてよ…」 {seagull:enter}{seagull:go to sand}カモメさんは、砂の上にすわりこんで、{seagull:face sleeping}とぶ気も、ありません。[short pause]そのとき…水が、さわっ。なにかが、ひらっ。{canvas:wind 0.7 25s}{sfx:breeze}びゅうーん！風がきた！{sailboat:live sails}帆が、まあるく、ぱんぱんにふくらみました。{girl:face surprised}{girl:live point}{girl:says}[excited]「見て！風が、帆をおしてる！」 {girl:face happy}{girl:live kite hold}ローラが糸をのばすと、たこが、すうっと空へ。{seagull:face happy}{seagull:go to girl kite}カモメさんも目をさまして、たこのそばへ、とんでいきました。{sailboat:go to sea right}そしてヨットは、風におされて、海をすいすい、わたっていきます。[happily]ヨットに風、たこに風、カモメさんのつばさにも風。{girl:hearts}みんな、おなじものを、まっていたのです。
